column13: Only a Forest Spirit frog wearing its complete set gets this; it fires on a timer, independent of whether it is hit or attacking. Every family_ability_heal_interval_s seconds of live combat (MergeRules, currently 4s) it finds the most-hurt living frog in the party (lowest hp/maxHp ratio) and heals it for 15% (S4 Bonus Value) of THAT frog's own max HP, capped so it never overheals past full (combat-live.js abilityTick(), the 'heal' branch around line 725-735). column13: Only a Frostbound frog wearing its complete set gets this; it triggers on the frog's own melee hits. Every time that frog lands a normal attack on an enemy (not on a tap or on its Double Strike analog, since Frostbound has no second attack type), it rolls a 20% chance (S4 Bonus Value) to freeze that enemy for family_ability_freeze_s seconds (MergeRules, currently 2s) via applyOnHit()'s 'freeze' branch (combat-live.js ~line 710). A frozen enemy's attack-timer clock is stopped entirely for that duration (step()'s enemy loop sets 'var clock = e.frozenS > 0 ? 0 : ...', so a frozen enemy neither attacks nor has its own cadence advance) — it does not stop the enemy from taking damage or being hit by anything else. A second freeze while one is already active simply restarts the duration at the new full value rather than stacking ('a refreeze restarts it', not additive).

column13: Only an Autumn Grove frog wearing its complete set gets this (its set has no mouth/aura slot, 2 head + 2 back variants instead — see row 46's General notes — but the ability check is the same whole-family match). Unlike the other nine abilities, S4 Bonus Value here is a regrow TIME in seconds, not a percent chance: the frog starts the fight already shielded (createFight(), 'if (ab.id === 'shield_cycle') { unit.shield = true; unit.abilT = 0; }', ~line 596). While shielded, the NEXT enemy attack that would hit it instead does zero damage and consumes the shield (step()'s enemy-attack loop, 'var blocked = !dodged && t.shield === true; ... if (blocked) { event.blocked = true; t.shield = false; t.abilT = t.abilVal; }', ~line 829-833) — the shield then regrows automatically after the family's own 6-second value (abilityTick()'s 'shield_cycle' branch, ~line 748-750), with no MergeRules knob (the sheet value is read directly as both the ability's own headline number and its timer). While unshielded the frog takes damage normally; the shield cannot be lost to anything except absorbing one hit.

column13: Only a Cat Burglar frog wearing its complete set gets this; it triggers on an ENEMY's attack, not the frog's own turn — it is evasion by misdirection rather than a dodge. Whenever an enemy's attack would target that frog, there is a 30% chance (S4 Bonus Value) the hit is retargeted instead to a different living frog the attack hasn't already hit this swing (combat-live.js stealthRetarget(), ~line 765-773: 'if (t.abil !== 'stealth' || abilityRng() >= t.abilVal) return t; var others = living.filter(...); return others[Math.floor(abilityRng() * others.length)]'). If every other frog is already a target of the same multi-hit attack, the retarget silently fails and the stealthy frog is hit as normal. Unlike Dodge, the damage isn't negated — it is redirected onto an ally, who takes it in full (subject to their own dodge/shield). There is no MergeRules knob and no duration; it is rolled fresh on every incoming attack.
